additional_info.subject: Note
additional_info.body:
please work accordingly,
Under >
5. Converter error codes (at the end of power converter error flag)
Blow points needs to be checked
1. Reboot the charger once & Check.
2. Modify the No the number of power converter in the group & check
If Still error remains the case then Inform region.
3.Please check if the power converter are properly connected to its shelf case.
4. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
5. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
6. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter is faulty, we suggest you to replace it.

additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
As reported by the end customer regarding the missing power converter in the charger, please follow the steps outlined below:
1.Please check if the power converter is properly connection to its shelf case.
2.Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
3.Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
4.If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter is faulty, we suggest you replace it.
Please find below attached knowledge article link for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - Dynamics 365
